title: [BUG] Potential issue with torchvision ImageNet in `create_dataset`?
author: ryan-caesar-ramos

comments.author: rwightman
comments.body: @ryan-caesar-ramos looks like torchvision removed the download argument, it used to be accepted but would error if True, now it's removed altogether. So for the ImageNet branch the download needs to be popped from kwargs, PR welcome or can get to it in a bit

comments.author: rwightman
comments.body: the default timm based image folder can resolve a fairly canonical imagenet dataset where train is in root/train, validation is in root/val or root/validation and all the classes for both train and val are in their own sysnet name based sub-folders
